# Vinayak Bhardwaj: full profile

> Founder of Virin Digital in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Designs and hand-builds websites, builds AI agent workflows and automation for businesses, produces long-form documentaries on Vinayak Tech, and is developing 12 Taneh, a mobile strategy game. Eight years of engineering and quality control behind him shape how he checks his work.

Canonical site: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/
Short index: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/llms.txt

## 1. What he makes

### Websites
Hand-built sites for founders and service businesses: quick on a phone, readable by search engines and AI assistants, and wired to send every enquiry somewhere a person will see it. vinayakbhardwaj.com and virindigital.com are built this way. Service page: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/web-design-kuala-lumpur

### AI agent workflows and automation
He takes a manual process, such as lead intake, reporting or document checks, writes down what a correct result looks like, then builds agents that do the work and a separate step that checks it. Failures go to a person, every run is logged, and each run has a cost cap. Delivered through Virin Digital (https://www.virindigital.com/). Service page: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/ai-automation-kuala-lumpur

### Documentaries and content
Vinayak Tech (https://www.youtube.com/@Vinayak_ai_tech) takes one claim about AI or money per episode, follows the documents and numbers behind it, and explains it in plain language. Research, scripts, motion graphics and sound are made in-house.

### Games and apps
12 Taneh is his own mobile game: the traditional South Asian board game also known as Bara Tehni and Alquerque, rebuilt for Android with four AI opponents, an interactive tutorial, daily puzzles and offline play. Built with TypeScript, React and Capacitor. In testing, coming to Google Play.

## 2. The build loop

Every project goes through the same four steps: brief, build, check, ship. Nothing ships until the check passes.

| Step | Website | AI workflow | Documentary | 12 Taneh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brief | who it is for, one action | what correct output looks like | one claim, primary sources | rules written as a spec |
| Build | hand-built, page by page | agents do the work | script, motion, sound | engine and four AI levels |
| Check | speed, keyboard, every form | a checker tests every run | facts traced, audio at -14 LUFS | automated rule and AI tests |
| Ship | live and measured | logged, capped, signed off | published | Google Play release |

Article: https://www.vinayakbhardwaj.com/how-i-check-ai-output

## 3. Case studies

### Staff evaluation platform (Client project, designer and developer, 2026)
- Client: a Kuala Lumpur group running façade-maintenance crews and a restaurant (not named at its request).
- Problem: reviews were ad hoc, with no shared standard across trades and hospitality roles, and safety could be outweighed by other strengths.
- Built: weighted role scorecards out of ten; a safety gate capping the score at 4 when safety compliance falls below the threshold; a private profile form that scores staff automatically; an owner overview by team. React, TypeScript, Postgres, automated tests on the scoring rules.
- Result: in use by the company's staff; submissions go straight into a database.

### Virin Digital (Founder, January 2024–present)
- Problem: small service businesses lose enquiries to slow sites and manual intake.
- Built: hand-built websites, and AI agent pipelines for research, content and enquiry triage, each with a checking step and a cost cap.
- Result: the studio's own site is live. Client case studies will be published as clients approve them.

### Vinayak Tech (Researcher and producer, 2024–present)
- Problem: stories about AI datacenters, power bills and pricing algorithms are usually told with opinions rather than documents.
- Built: a research process starting from primary sources, a code-driven motion graphics pipeline in Remotion, and audio mastered to -14 LUFS.
- Result: six long-form episodes published since September 2026, including "The $700 Billion AI Lie: The Datacenter Autopsy", "The Secret AI Tax Hidden On Your Electric Bill" and "The Algorithm That Secretly Raised Your Rent".

### 12 Taneh (Developer, 2026)
- Problem: apps for this traditional game are dated, flat and crowded with ads, with little help for anyone learning the rules.
- Built: a rules engine for the 25-point board including chained and mandatory captures, four AI opponents from beginner to master, an interactive tutorial, daily puzzles and offline play.
- Result: Android build in testing with automated checks on the rules, the AI and saved games; being prepared for Google Play.

### vinayakbhardwaj.com (Designer and developer, 2026)
- Built: a dark editorial design system, a scroll-driven build loop, page transitions without a framework, and structured data for search engines and AI assistants.
- Result: every page scores 99–100 in Google Lighthouse for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO.
